facts.fact: 她把 Emmy 放下，Emmy 背着装 Bunny 的小背包跑在前头。
facts.anchor: I lower Emmy to the ground and she runs off ahead of us, Bunny bouncing in his little backpack on her back.

facts.fact: 回家让她意识到想要的一切都在牧场。
facts.anchor: But being home has made me realize that everything I ever wanted is right here on the ranch.

facts.fact: 她和 Everett 十三岁生日各收到一顶牛仔帽，至今仍戴。
facts.anchor: Both Everett and I received hats for our thirteenth birthdays, and we both still wear them today.

facts.fact: Brooks 把 Emmy 抱起来放进后排安全座椅。
facts.anchor: Brooks scoops his niece into his arms and flings open one of the back doors, leaning in to tuck Emmy into her car seat.

facts.fact: 他手动换挡满脸高兴，她觉得坐副驾也值。
facts.anchor: the absolute glee on Brooks’s face as he manually shifts up through the gears is worth riding shotgun

facts.fact: 他逐一报出四人从小的固定点单（培根烧烤酱/多一片番茄/蓝纹/胡椒杰克炸洋葱）。
facts.anchor: “Cheeseburger with bacon and barbecue, right? Ev has a cheeseburger with an extra tomato slice. You have bacon and barbecue sauce. Jody’s is blue cheese, because he’s insane, and mine is pepper jack cheese and crispy fried onion.

facts.fact: 他付午饭钱时抽出几张现金交给 Emmy 转交 Miss Celia。
facts.anchor: Brooks pulls a couple crisp bills from his wallet and gives them to Emmy, who hands them over proudly.

facts.fact: 她用糖霜画出带星星的牛仔靴曲奇（灵感来自 Ruth 上周的红靴）。
facts.anchor: Iced on the surface of the cookie is a tiny pair of boots, complete with stars stitched on them. They were inspired by the red ones I saw Ruth wearing last week.
